title: Purple Blotch Prophylactic Advisory
summary: High morning dew and moderate daytime temperature favor purple blotch outbreak in Nashik & Pune belts.
action_points: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/L or Tebuconazole @ 1ml/L within the next 48 hours.
Ensure spray window is between 07:00 AM - 10:30 AM when wind speed is under 10 km/h.
Add sticker/spreader agent (0.5ml/L) due to waxy onion foliage.

title: Downy Mildew & Berry Thinning Protocols
summary: Recent cloud cover raises humidity above 75%. Protect inflorescence clusters.
action_points: Apply Potassium Phosphonate @ 3g/L for systemic oomycete protection.
Perform manual cluster tipping to ensure uniform berry elongation.
Check underside of lower leaves for oily patches.

title: Early Shoot Borer & Fertigation Schedule
summary: Tillering stage requires balanced nitrogen top dressing and soil moisture preservation.
action_points: Apply first split fertigation: Urea 50kg + MOP 25kg per acre.
Carry out partial earthing up to suppress late tiller emergence.

title: First Irrigation & Weed Control Window
summary: Crown Root Initiation (21-25 DAS) is the most yield-sensitive stage for wheat.
action_points: Give first critical irrigation immediately if not done within 25 days of sowing.
Apply 50% recommended Nitrogen dose as top dressing after field attains optimum moisture.
Monitor field borders for yellow rust patches.
